description: This file defines the FnStream class within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which implements the StreamInterface to allow for dynamic, function-based stream behaviors. It enables flexible composition and extension of streams by specifying method behaviors via a hash of callables.

classes.name: FnStream
classes.description: A stream implementation that delegates its methods to user-provided callables, facilitating flexible, composable stream behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FnStream with a hash of methods, dynamically creating function properties.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Raises an exception if an undefined method is accessed, indicating not implemented.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Calls the custom close function if provided when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the FnStream object by throwing an exception.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a decorated stream by combining a given StreamInterface with additional method behaviors, defaulting missing methods to the stream itself.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the stream by invoking its dedicated method.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Calls the custom close function.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Calls the custom detach function.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calls the custom getSize function.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Calls the custom tell function.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Calls the custom eof function.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Calls the custom isSeekable function.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Calls the custom rewind function.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Calls the custom seek function with offset and whence.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Calls the custom isWritable function.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Calls the custom write function with provided string.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Calls the custom isReadable function.

methods.name: read
